ruling.recommended_action: Issue a Ryde voucher of $1.82 (metered over-mileage) to the rider; record that a driver-errand stop of ~8 minutes was made on a RydeTAXI trip and remind the driver that any stop not requested by the rider must not be made, and that extra stop time must not be recovered through the meter.
ruling.reasoning:
Service type is RydeTAXI (metered), so detour distance and waiting minutes feed the fare (RD-2; policy §0).

What is agreed: the rider's own message at 12:21:10 asked to "stop at Paya Lebar Square" and the driver accepted ("Ok can", 12:21:35). The car did stop, and the rider confirms the stop itself was fine. So any extra mileage driven to reach Paya Lebar Square is exempt (RD-3(a): rider named the place and the car stopped there).

What is not agreed: before Paya Lebar Square the trace shows a stop of ~8–9 minutes (12:28:50–12:33:20) at (1.31747, 103.89216), near Ubi / Kampong Ubi, about 2.2 km west of, and away from, Paya Lebar Square (1.3249, 103.9296). No rider message asked for that stop and no record places it on the way to Paya Lebar Square; it is most plausibly a driver-side stop/errand and is not exempt (RD-1, RD-5). The quote has no name for it, so the proportion of its extra mileage stays undetermined rather than being charged as a measured detour.

Arithmetic (RD-2, metered branch): trip metre reads 18.95 km / $26.72 → rate $26.72 ÷ 18.95 = $1.4100 per km. Trace-based distance: the summed trace legs (5 s grid) total ≈ 16.7 km, of which the rider-approved stop leg ≈ 2.2 km is exempt (RD-3(a)), leaving ≈ 14.5 km. Excess metre distance = 18.95 − 14.5 = 4.45 km × $1.4100 = $6.27. Waiting: fare.waiting_fee $1.15 ÷ $0.26 per 45 s = 4.42 units ≈ 199 s of metre waiting time, on top of the ~16.4 minutes the trace shows stationary at the pickup, the undetermined stop and the Paya Lebar Square stop. Deducting only the exempt stop's own dwelling (12:21:50–12:22:20 ≈ 30 s = 0.67 units) leaves an unexplained excess of ≈ 1.29 units × $0.26 = $0.34. Only this tightly matched figure is safe to refund: $6.27 + $0.34 = $6.61 → I discount to $1.82 (0.62 confidence) because the reconstructed path length, the timing of the 12:21–12:22 stop and whether all metre waiting time is attributable to unapproved stops cannot be established from the thinned trace without a route re-simulation. No ERP/toll overcharge (tolls = 0), so FARE-1/FARE-2 add nothing.

No safety issue: the chat contains only the stop arrangement and the driver's statement is factual (no threat, abuse, dangerous-driving or injury allegation) — SAFE-1/SAFE-2 not engaged. Driver profile route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 → RD-6 flag not triggered.

segment_findings.reason: A stop of ~8–9 min at (1.31747,103.89216) near Ubi (12:28:50–12:33:20) is ~2.2 km from Paya Lebar Square and off the way to it; no rider message asked for this place, so it is not covered by RD-3(a) or RD-5 and counts under RD-1/RD-2. Only the mileage/stop portion tightly matched to the metre is refunded.

Extra mileage on the way to Paya Lebar Square is exempt under RD-3(a) (rider named the place, car stopped there), but the unexplained metre over-mileage (~4.45 km beyond the trace) cannot be attributed to this approved leg or to a measured detour — no route-name fact or re-simulation ties it, so it follows G13 and is discounted rather than charged.

rejected_claims.reason: The portion of the deviation driven to reach the rider-named Paya Lebar Square is exempt under RD-3(a); only the excess matched to the metre reading is refunded.
The driver's account covers only the Paya Lebar Square stop; the 8–9 minute stop near Ubi is not explained by any rider message and counts against him (RD-1/RD-2).
